$schema-comment: Locale registry for the multilingual scaffolding (4-week plan invariant 15). Each entry describes one locale the project can render in. Adding a new locale = (1) add an entry here, (2) drop a translation JSON at static/i18n/<code>.json. No app-code changes needed — the registry drives locale selection, direction (LTR/RTL), and the language-picker UI.

locales.name: Arabic
locales.rationaleNote: Highest-priority post-grant locale: Aïcha persona + significant share of Anerkennung migration pathway users. RTL infrastructure landed in W3 D15 so translators can plug strings in via Weblate without app-code changes.

locales.name: Ukrainian
locales.rationaleNote: Olga persona — §24 Aufenthaltsgesetz Ukraine. Pluralisation is complex (3 forms); the Intl.PluralRules path handles it correctly without per-locale code.

locales.name: Turkish
locales.rationaleNote: Yusuf persona + large Turkish-speaking labour-market cohort in Germany. Agglutinative morphology — translators may need longer keys; the loader handles arbitrary key length.

locales.name: Romanian
locales.rationaleNote: Maria persona — EU intra-mobility cohort. Pluralisation has 3 forms (one, few, other) — same scaffolding as Ukrainian handles it.
